entities.summary: Franchy Cordero Vargas is a Dominican professional baseball outfielder and first baseman for the Toros de Tijuana of the Mexican League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the San Diego Padres, Kansas City Royals, Boston Red Sox, and New York Yankees, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Saitama Seibu Lions.
